options.label: Data journalism: bold and direct
options.rationale: Thick accent lines and bars with outside value labels make the headline gains (MATH 50.3% vs 6.9%) instantly readable from the back of the room.

options.label: Engineering report: gridded
options.rationale: Gridlines, axis lines and striped rows suit the dense Table 3 and the pass@k versus majority-vote curves that need precise reading.

options.label: Editorial: quiet and airy
options.rationale: Wide gaps, inside labels and a bold-only table highlight keep the sober, evidence-driven tone for the subtopic bar charts and error analysis.

options.label: Minimal ink: nothing extra
options.rationale: Stripping frames, axes and grid lets the worked LaTeX examples and the memorization scatter plots carry the argument unadorned.
